entities.title: The same match in every browser and on the server
entities.summary: The engine must give bit-identical results everywhere.
entities.requirement: Engine code uses only + − × ÷ and Math.sqrt, and draws random numbers only from its own seeded generator, so a match replays exactly in every browser and in the Worker.
entities.measuredBy: The replay tests: a recorded match replays to the same score; the same seed plays the same match; browsers in lockstep play the same steps.

origin.description: The repository's agent instructions: the games' engines must stay deterministic.

entities.title: Replays are cheap for the server
entities.summary: The Worker replays a whole match on every submission, so a replay must be fast.
entities.requirement: A long match against the hard computer replays in well under half a second; the README gives about 5 ms for a 10-minute match.
entities.measuredBy: test/match.test.ts, "a long match replays quickly enough for the server": under 500 ms.

origin.description: Rally's README, written for players and developers.

sources.symbol: a long match replays quickly enough for the server

entities.title: Everything from this origin
entities.summary: The page loads nothing from elsewhere except Cloudflare Web Analytics.
entities.requirement: The page's content security policy allows scripts, styles, images and connections only from icelander.net, plus Cloudflare's analytics beacon; no framing, forms, plugins or base URL changes.
entities.measuredBy: public/_headers, read by Cloudflare's static assets.

entities.title: The ball never passes through a paddle
entities.summary: Even at top speed, a ball that meets a paddle is returned.
entities.requirement: The ball is moved in sub-steps of at most a third of its size.
entities.measuredBy: test/rules.test.ts, "even at top speed the ball can't slip through a paddle".
